a.lede: Takeoffs from airports throughout the US largely stopped on Friday after the FAA issued a national ground stop at 3:44PM ET "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety," while planes in the air will be allowed to land. a.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours

b.lede: The government cited a nationwide communications failure among air traffic control systems as the reason for the sudden grounding on Friday.
b.title: FAA Grounds All US Flights Until Further Notice
